svg.title: Lilly’s 11 retatrutide lawsuits: 3 dropped with prejudice, 8 still open
svg.desc: Lilly’s 11 retatrutide lawsuits: 3 dropped with prejudice, 8 still open. Aesthetic Envy (E.D. Cal. 2:26-cv-02764), filed 2026-08-12: dismissed with prejudice. Astra (W.D. Tex. 5:26-cv-05147), filed 2026-08-12: open; amended Aug 31 to add an unidentified operator; Lilly notice of voluntary dismissal Sept 2; Sept 30 motion for discovery to identify the defendant. Legendary Peptides (E.D. Tex. 1:26-cv-00347), filed 2026-08-12: open; motion to dismiss filed Oct 2; case management conference Nov 30. Striker Pharmacy (S.D. Tex. 4:26-cv-06563), filed 2026-08-12: open; response to complaint due Oct 30; discovery through Aug 10, 2027. Texas Peptides (W.D. Tex. 5:26-cv-05146), filed 2026-08-12: dismissed with prejudice. Lone Star Peptide (S.D. Tex. 4:26-cv-06562), filed 2026-08-12: dismissed with prejudice. American Peptides (W.D. La. 5:26-cv-04146), filed 2026-10-08: open; summons issued Oct 16. Individual seller (LiveWell Peptides) (N.D. Tex. 3:26-cv-03514), filed 2026-10-08: open. Cenexa Labs (S.D. Tex. 4:26-cv-08806), filed 2026-10-08: open. Southlake Mhya (Medrein) (N.D. Tex. 4:26-cv-01294), filed 2026-10-08: open. MedShape Weight Loss Clinic (D. Ariz. 2:26-cv-07361), filed 2026-10-08: open; service executed Oct 15.
